channel.title: Crochet Baby Gifts
channel.description: Size charts, yarn guides and gifting advice for handmade baby gifts.

item.title: Yarn Weight Chart for Baby Projects (0–7, and What Each One Is Good For)
item.description: The full standard yarn weight system from lace to jumbo, with the hook size and gauge for each — and which weights actually suit baby blankets, hats, booties and toys.

item.title: What to Give at a Baby Shower When You Can't Crochet
item.description: How to give a handmade-feeling baby shower gift without making one — what new parents actually run out of, what gets quietly returned, and how to make a bought gift feel personal.

item.title: The Best Yarn for Baby Blankets: Soft, Washable and Safe
item.description: How to choose yarn for a baby blanket — the four properties that actually matter, what each fibre does in a wash, and why the softest yarn in the shop is often the wrong answer.

item.title: Is Acrylic Yarn Safe for Babies? An Honest Answer
item.description: Whether acrylic yarn is safe for baby blankets and clothes — the flammability question nobody addresses, the softness myth, and where the real concerns actually lie.

item.title: How to Wash a Crochet Baby Blanket Without Ruining It
item.description: How to wash a handmade crochet baby blanket by fibre — machine settings, what stretches it, how to dry it flat, and the two mistakes that cause permanent damage.

item.title: How Much Yarn for a Baby Blanket? Yardage by Size and Yarn Weight
item.description: Estimate yarn for a crochet baby blanket by size, yarn weight and stitch — with the square-inch method that lets you work out any size yourself, not just the ones on the chart.

item.title: Crochet or Knit for Baby Gifts? How to Choose
item.description: The real differences between crochet and knitting for baby items — speed, fabric, stretch, yarn use and which is easier to learn — with a straight recommendation for each project.

item.title: Crochet Hook Size Chart: US, UK and Metric Conversions
item.description: Every crochet hook size converted between metric, US letter-number and old UK numbering — plus why the US letters are not reliable and the millimetre figure is the only one to trust.

item.title: Crochet Baby Blanket Size Chart: Every Size, Newborn to Toddler
item.description: The standard crochet baby blanket sizes in inches and centimetres, from preemie to toddler — plus the one measurement that actually matters and why the charts disagree.

item.title: Are Crochet Blankets Safe for Babies to Sleep With?
item.description: The direct answer on crochet blankets and infant sleep, what current safe-sleep guidance actually says, and how to give a handmade blanket that gets used safely.
